title: Heart Rent Notice
one_line_summary: Aachu jokingly asks Zuv to pay rent for living in her heart.
emotional_hook: The person you love has become so permanent inside you that the only thing left to do is tease them about rent.
setup: A cozy everyday interior with warm negative space above the couple.
escalation: Aachu holds a tiny open wallet or handwritten rent note toward Zuv with mock-serious affection.
payoff: Zuv smiles sheepishly and points to his chest or offers a tiny paper heart as payment.
relationship_truth: Love becomes a home, and couples turn that permanence into tiny private jokes.
risks: Do not make Aachu look stern.
Do not make the prop overpower the faces.
Do not place faces too close together in a way that risks merging.
